title: sdks: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go + parity and version bump v1.64.0
author: Asha Patel
description: This PR applies a coordinated set of changes across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs to (1) standardize auth handling and retry semantics, (2) improve streaming API ergonomics and error surfaces, (3) fix small parity bugs between SDKs, and (4) bump packaged SDK versions to v1.64.0. Motivation: downstream services observe divergent retry behavior and confusing streaming APIs across language SDKs which makes cross-service debugging and onboarding harder. The changes here are intentionally small per-language but coordinated at the API contract level so library consumers have predictable behavior. High-level checklist: - [x] Unify auth token refresh flow and error propagation across SDKs - [x] Implement shared retry policy (idempotency-aware, jittered backoff) and surface config at client ctor - [x] Stream API ergonomic improvements: consistent async iterator behavior in Python/TS and channel-style reader in Go - [x] Parity fixes for header names, metadata propagation, and error codes - [x] Bumped SDK package versions to v1.64.0 and updated changelogs - [x] Added unit and integration tests for retry/backoff behavior and streaming reconnects - [x] CI green on all three SDKs Implementation notes: Python: added AuthHandler abstraction (sdk/auth.py), changed Client to accept retry_policy dataclass, converted streaming.stream_chat() to an async generator that yields typed events, added retry tests in tests/test_retries.py. TypeScript: introduced AuthManager (src/auth.ts) with unified token refresh hooks, exported StreamClient with async iterator interface, updated types for streaming events and improved docs examples. Go: refactored auth package to expose TokenRefresher interface (sdk/auth/auth.go), normalized retry middleware in sdk/retry, added ReaderStream pattern for streaming responses and updated examples. Parity fixes: normalized header casing (X-Redwood-Request-Id), preserved request metadata through redirects, harmonized error type names across languages (RedwoodError). Version bumps: python/setup.cfg -> 1.64.0, typescript/package.json -> 1.64.0, go/sdk/version.go -> 1.64.0. Backwards compatibility: changes are non-breaking for typical usage patterns; streaming ergonomics are additive and old helper wrappers remain functional. Migration guide: small notes added to SDK changelogs describing the new retry config and streaming iterator usage.
commits: fix(retries): align backoff and idempotency handling, add jitter
feat(streaming): ergonomic async iterator for python and ts; ReaderStream for go
chore: bump versions to v1.64.0 and update changelogs
test: add flaky-resistant retry/integration tests for all SDKs

release_notes:
- SDKs: unified auth and retry semantics across Python/TS/Go
- Streaming: improved ergonomics (async iterators and ReaderStream) and reconnection behavior
- Parity: header/metadata and error type harmonization
- Bumped SDK versions to v1.64.0
